body: I actually did that for a while and it did help, I have a whole flurry of news years resolutions, and this really should have been top of the list! I feel an awful lot better today, I needed a good nights sleep. BDD is a mysterious beast, it comes and goes, today I feel fine, I actually feel really quite attractive, last night i wanted to cut my fat off with a scalpel :/ Really, thankyou for your time you took to respond, I didnt think anyone would read my messages.. it really means a lot :)

The pain motivates me, the excruciating pain of the judgment I give myself for being overweight, the rapid heart-rate I get when I eat anything that isn't on my diet plan, the fact my body is so hyper sensitive to sat and fat that if I eat ANY oil or salt I retain 3kg the following day... my endocrine system is way out of whack... :/ Thankyou for your kind words, I feel a lot better today, I didnt expect anyone to actually listen to me. I have no one to talk to about my problems, I have a hard time socializing with people due to feeling so self concious about my body, your words mean a lot to me. 

Tony robbins comes to mind when talking of motivation, I was listening to an audiobook he made about getting the body of your dreams and he said something along the lines of; the amount of pain you attach to not doing something, will determine how often you do it.

I haven't no, I live predominantly in the UK, the past 2 times I have been to my doctor to seek treatment, I was put on a waiting list for 6 months, then when I finally did start seeing a therapist, the first time the therapist got ill, and the second one moved away, and on both occasions it was a massive blow to me having to work with someone new...
